title: Demo: Complete Blood Count (CBC) Lab Report
report_text:
CLINICAL PATHOLOGY LABORATORY REPORT
Patient: Anonymous (Age: 32 / Female)

Investigation: Complete Blood Count
Hemoglobin : 10.2 g/dL (Reference Range: 12.0 - 15.5)
WBC Count : 7500 /cumm (Reference Range: 4000 - 11000)
Platelet Count : 210000 /cumm (Reference Range: 150000 - 450000)
ESR : 26 mm/hr

items.plain_explanation: Hemoglobin is an iron-rich protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen throughout your body.
White blood cells (WBC) are cells of the immune system that help the body fight infections.
Platelets are blood cell fragments that help the blood clot to stop bleeding.
Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) is a marker that reflects general inflammation in the body.
